payload.title: Custom docked-lid policy falsely suspends after transient dock-state loss

expectation.text: The installed custom lid policy was intended to keep a closed laptop awake when it was externally powered at the desk dock.

payload.observed: The first custom policy asked systemd to suspend when logind briefly reported the dock absent, causing an unexpected suspend during the externally powered docked session. This is a corrective repair to a custom policy, not a claimed stock Omarchy defect.
